native_hourly_definition: State immediately after hourly surface exchange and release. Sparse kg per native cell; ug/m3 = kg*1e9/(500*500*layer_thickness).
daily_definition: 24 hourly endpoints averaged with mass/24 per particle, matching the frozen CPU baseline.
trajectory_policy: Deterministic diagnostic subsample: stable ID modulo nper == 0. One primary per source/event; secondary IDs use same systematic rule. Not a full-count trajectory data set or a random/unbiased estimate.
mass_accounting: Native fields contain all particles including the near region. Near queries and trajectories are views, never added to regional mass. Each segment occurs once with a 4-bit overlapping-envelope mask.
near_envelope: Horizontal radius 500 m around each outlet, all modeled heights. Actual accepted reflected pieces including birth-to-first-step and lateral exits.
loss_timing: Contact uptake at piece endpoints; wet/chemical loss at step end. Terrain epsilon offsets have zero duration.
residence_definition: Accepted-path intersection with outside-stack cylinder radius max(5 m,2*diameter), outlet orthometric height +/-5 m. This model does not resolve an in-pipe jet or in-pipe residence. Returning entries include aged parcels crossing from outside, not just newborn particles.
daily_surface_pools: daily_surface_pools/day_DD_end.npz; actual day-end states, not daily averages (provided for benchmark and production)
temporal_support: Regional fields are full-count hourly endpoint mass. Collar residence is selected-path time support within each 30 s step. They are distinct diagnostics; a visual crossfade does not form a conservative concentration field. Display expansion factor is not actual parcel mass.
